en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5639 - Ibn Udhaynah narrated from Zurarah, Bukayr, Muhammad ibn Muslim, Al-Fuḍayl, and Burayd ibn Muawiyah from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them) who said:
"The grandfather, when inheriting alongside the paternal siblings, is considered as one of the brothers."
